item.text: {"summary":"The current UTF-8 to UTF-16 implementation includes its trailing null in the reported size and string result. Its supplementary-plane conversion also shifts the code point by 9 bits when forming the high surrogate; the UTF-16 formula requires a 10-bit shift. The supplied implementation, API contract, and failing assertions are enough to identify a focused repair.","hypotheses":["The converter appends a terminator to its buffer, but `size()` includes it, so `str()` and the string-view conversion expose it as content.","The high-surrogate calculation uses `cp >> 9` instead of the 10-bit offset required for a UTF-16 surrogate pair."],"queries":[],"reads":[],"ready":true}
